WHAT EACH MECHANISM IS THERE FOR — every row below is a thing I found in the practice data, not a hypothetical
36 days of total silence, vs a 2-day historical max gap (sc. 03)
No event is ever emitted, so nothing event-driven can fire
Salary $3,800/14d stops, replaced by $1,400 benefits, then nothing
Reacting to arrivals cannot see a non-arrival
$12,000 wire and $12,000 ledger withdrawal, 1 second apart
$10,000 out of savings and $10,000 into checking, 1 second apart
Sweep-pair detector → one drawdown, not two events
Reads as a $10k exfiltration and trips a fraud rule
$600 electronics purchase explained the next day as a baby monitor

Red herrings are the largest amounts; real signals are $85–$500

Only ~8% of live events carry any signal at all
Tier-0 reflex gates Tier-1; LLMs never see routine traffic
An LLM per event is 12× the cost and 12× the hallucination surface
